context_requirements: Intact class I PI3K signaling with active PI3K/AKT output (e.g., PIK3CA mutation/amplification, PTEN loss, HER2/ERBB2 amplification, or RTK-driven activation)
Dependence on PI3K signaling for proliferation/survival
FOXO transcription factors not constitutively excluded from the nucleus by other mechanisms
falsifiers: No decrease in AKT pathway output markers or no increase in FOXO target genes (e.g., DDIT4, TSC22D3) at 6 h in any line
No reduction in MYC or cell-cycle/proliferation genes at 24 h in PIK3CA-mutant or PTEN-null lines
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines including PI3K-independent lines
Predominant interferon or unfolded protein response without PI3K pathway attenuation

evidence.supports: Pan-class I PI3K inhibitor BAY 80-6946 inhibits AKT phosphorylation and shows preferential activity in PIK3CA-mutant/HER2-overexpressing breast cancer lines
PI3K inhibitor GDC-0941 modulates PI3K pathway biomarkers and induces apoptosis-related Bcl-2 family regulators, especially with MAPK co-inhibition
PI3K inhibition downregulates MYC protein and induces apoptosis in MYC-dependent cancers
PI3K inhibitor PX-866 inhibits PI3K/AKT signaling in glioblastoma and increases autophagy without marked apoptosis
